description: Baseline Electron knowledge base with minimal harness

features.name: Window Launch
features.description: Electron app opens a BrowserWindow with correct dimensions and preload script
features.evidence: Configured a 1200x800 BrowserWindow with the compiled preload and context isolation. npm run dev completed Electron launch without runtime exceptions.

features.name: Document List Panel
features.description: Left sidebar shows imported documents with empty state message
features.evidence: Renderer loads persisted document metadata on startup and shows an empty state. The preload bridge now has a runtime availability check; native picker behavior is tracked separately until manually verified.

features.name: Question Panel
features.description: Bottom input bar accepts questions and submits via IPC
features.evidence: QuestionPanel submits through the typed preload API; the main process returns locally retrieved passage excerpts with document/chunk citations and persists Q&A history. npm run check passes.

features.name: Data Directory
features.description: PersistenceService creates and manages userData/knowledge-base-data directory
features.evidence: PersistenceService creates the userData/knowledge-base-data directory and its document/index subdirectories at startup. Build and type checks pass.

features.name: Native Document Import
features.description: Native file picker imports and indexes .txt and .md documents
features.evidence: The preload bundle and startup bridge diagnostics are implemented. The current execution environment terminates Electron during GPU process initialization before the renderer runtime check; manually verify window.knowledgeBase, click + Import, choose a .txt or .md file, and confirm it appears indexed in the list.
